title: Glueing morphisms and sheaves of modules along an open covering
statement: Let $(X,\mathcal O_X)$ be a ringed space, $X=\bigcup_{i\in J}U_i$ an open covering, $U_{ij}=U_i\cap U_j$, $U_{ijk}=U_i\cap U_j\cap U_k$, and write $|_V$ for restriction to an open $V$ (of sheaves of modules [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category] and of their morphisms). (1) (Glueing morphisms.) Let $\mathcal F,\mathcal G$ be $\mathcal O_X$-modules and $\varphi_i:\mathcal F|_{U_i}\to\mathcal G|_{U_i}$ $\mathcal O_{U_i}$-linear maps with $\varphi_i|_{U_{ij}}=\varphi_j|_{U_{ij}}$ for all $i,j$. Then there is a unique $\mathcal O_X$-linear $\varphi:\mathcal F\to\mathcal G$ with $\varphi|_{U_i}=\varphi_i$ for all $i$; in particular two $\mathcal O_X$-linear maps that agree on every $U_i$ are equal. (2) (Glueing sheaves.) Let $\mathcal F_i$ be $\mathcal O_{U_i}$-modules and $\varphi_{ij}:\mathcal F_i|_{U_{ij}}\to\mathcal F_j|_{U_{ij}}$ $\mathcal O_{U_{ij}}$-linear isomorphisms with $\varphi_{ik}=\varphi_{jk}\circ\varphi_{ij}$ on $U_{ijk}$ for all $i,j,k$ (cocycle condition). Then there are an $\mathcal O_X$-module $\mathcal F$ and $\mathcal O_{U_i}$-linear isomorphisms $\varphi_i:\mathcal F|_{U_i}\to\mathcal F_i$ with $\varphi_{ij}\circ\varphi_i|_{U_{ij}}=\varphi_j|_{U_{ij}}$ for all $i,j$.

source.place: Sheaves on Spaces, Section 00AK (section-glueing-sheaves, line 5071): Lemma 04TN (lemma-glue-maps, line 5078) for (1), Lemma 00AL (lemma-glue-sheaves, line 5192) and Lemma 00AM (lemma-glue-sheaves-structures, line 5253) for (2); O-linearity of the glued map in (1) is checked on the U_i
